a.lede: Anthropic employee confirms that Claude Code now has orders not to reproduce game IP — company "iterating to ensure [...] the right balance"
a.title: Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits to prevent game cloning, users report blocking reverse engineering tasks

b.lede: The update is expected to reduce false positives and allow game developers to use the tool for their own legitimate projects without getting blocked.
b.title: Anthropic loosens Claude's game cloning ban
